# Cluster-rate coefficient-of-variation approximation
# Field Trials of Health Interventions, Chapter 5, Section 6.1
# With additive one-cluster correction

# Input parameters
p_control <- 0.010      # Control event rate per child-week
p_treatment <- 0.005    # Treatment event rate per child-week
m_cluster <- 2500       # Exposure per cluster (child-weeks)
kappa <- 0.25           # Between-cluster coefficient of variation
alpha <- 0.05           # Two-sided significance level
target_power <- 0.90    # Target power
z_alpha <- qnorm(1 - alpha/2)  # Two-sided critical value
z_beta <- qnorm(target_power)   # Power parameter (one-sided)

cat("=== Cluster-Rate Coefficient-of-Variation Sample Size Calculation ===\n")
cat("Control rate (per child-week):", p_control, "\n")
cat("Treatment rate (per child-week):", p_treatment, "\n")
cat("Exposure per cluster (child-weeks):", m_cluster, "\n")
cat("Between-cluster CV (κ):", kappa, "\n")
cat("Two-sided alpha:", alpha, "\n")
cat("Target power:", target_power, "\n")
cat("z_alpha (two-sided):", z_alpha, "\n")
cat("z_beta (power):", z_beta, "\n\n")

# The approximation formula (without one-cluster correction):
# n = (z_alpha + z_beta)^2 * [κ^2 * (p_0 + p_1) + (p_0 + p_1)/(m_cluster)] / (p_0 - p_1)^2
# 
# With additive one-cluster correction:
# n_corrected = n + 1

# Difference in rates
delta_p <- p_control - p_treatment
cat("Difference in rates (p_0 - p_1):", delta_p, "\n\n")

# Average rate
p_avg <- (p_control + p_treatment) / 2
cat("Average rate (p_0 + p_1)/2:", p_avg, "\n")
cat("Sum of rates (p_0 + p_1):", p_control + p_treatment, "\n\n")

# Variance inflation term from CV approximation
# The cluster-rate CV method accounts for:
# 1. Between-cluster heterogeneity in rates: κ^2 * (p_0 + p_1)
# 2. Within-cluster Poisson variation: (p_0 + p_1) / m_cluster

variance_term_cv <- kappa^2 * (p_control + p_treatment)
variance_term_poisson <- (p_control + p_treatment) / m_cluster
total_variance_term <- variance_term_cv + variance_term_poisson

cat("Variance term from between-cluster CV: κ^2 * (p_0 + p_1) =", variance_term_cv, "\n")
cat("Variance term from Poisson variation: (p_0 + p_1) / m =", variance_term_poisson, "\n")
cat("Total variance term:", total_variance_term, "\n\n")

# Sample size per arm (before one-cluster correction)
z_sum_squared <- (z_alpha + z_beta)^2
numerator <- z_sum_squared * total_variance_term
denominator <- delta_p^2

n_uncorrected <- numerator / denominator

cat("(z_alpha + z_beta)^2 =", z_sum_squared, "\n")
cat("Numerator:", numerator, "\n")
cat("Denominator:", denominator, "\n")
cat("Uncorrected clusters per arm: n =", n_uncorrected, "\n\n")

# Apply additive one-cluster correction
n_corrected <- n_uncorrected + 1
cat("After one-cluster correction: n + 1 =", n_corrected, "\n\n")

# Round upward to next integer
n_final <- ceiling(n_corrected)
cat("Final clusters per arm (rounded upward):", n_final, "\n\n")

# Verification: compute achieved power at the final sample size
# We can verify by computing power backward using the formula
# Rearranging: power = P(Z > z_crit - (effect size * sqrt(n)))

# For the two-sided test:
# Effect size per cluster = delta_p / sqrt(variance_term)
se_per_cluster <- sqrt(total_variance_term / n_final)
z_critical_one_sided <- z_alpha  # For one-sided test at two-sided alpha/2
effect_size_standardized <- delta_p / sqrt(total_variance_term)
z_power_achieved <- sqrt(n_final) * effect_size_standardized

# For two-sided test, power = P(|Z| > z_alpha) under H1
# This is approximately P(Z > z_alpha - effect_size_standardized * sqrt(n))
power_achieved <- pnorm(z_power_achieved - z_alpha)

cat("=== Verification of Achieved Power ===\n")
cat("Standard error per cluster:", se_per_cluster, "\n")
cat("Standardized effect size:", effect_size_standardized, "\n")
cat("Z-statistic for power (noncentrality):", z_power_achieved, "\n")
cat("Achieved power (approximate):", power_achieved, "\n\n")

# More precise power calculation for two-sided test:
# Under H1, the test statistic sqrt(n) * delta_p / sqrt(total_variance_term) follows N(delta_p*sqrt(n)/sqrt(variance), 1)
# Power = P(|Z| > z_alpha | H1) where Z ~ N(sqrt(n)*delta_p/sqrt(variance), 1)
# = P(Z > z_alpha) + P(Z < -z_alpha) where Z ~ N(noncentrality, 1)

noncentrality <- sqrt(n_final) * delta_p / sqrt(total_variance_term)
power_upper <- 1 - pnorm(z_alpha - noncentrality)
power_lower <- pnorm(-z_alpha - noncentrality)
power_two_sided <- power_upper + power_lower

cat("=== Refined Power Calculation (Two-Sided) ===\n")
cat("Noncentrality parameter:", noncentrality, "\n")
cat("P(Z > z_alpha | H1):", power_upper, "\n")
cat("P(Z < -z_alpha | H1):", power_lower, "\n")
cat("Total two-sided power:", power_two_sided, "\n\n")

# Final results
cat("=== FINAL RESULTS ===\n")
cat("Sample size (clusters per arm):", n_final, "\n")
cat("Method: cluster_rate_cv (with one-cluster correction)\n")
cat("Achieved power:", round(power_two_sided, 4), "\n")

var_total <- var_cv + var_poisson

n_uncorr <- (z_sum^2 * var_total) / (delta_p^2)

cat("Sample size calculation:\n")
cat("  (z_α + z_β)²:", z_sum^2, "\n")
cat("  n_uncorrected = (z_α + z_β)² × Var / (Δp)²\n")
cat("  n_uncorrected:", n_uncorr, "\n\n")

# Additive one-cluster correction

cat("After one-cluster correction: n + 1 =", n_corrected, "\n")

# Final rounding (upward)
n_final <- ceiling(n_corrected)
cat("After ceiling rounding: n_final =", n_final, "\n\n")

# Power verification at the final sample size
# ==================================================

compute_power_at_n <- function(n_per_arm, p0, p1, m, kappa, alpha) {
  # Variance per cluster
  var_total <- kappa^2 * (p0 + p1) + (p0 + p1) / m
  
  # Standard error of rate difference
  se <- sqrt(var_total / n_per_arm)
  
  # Effect size
  delta_p <- p0 - p1
  
  # Noncentrality parameter (for one-sided test)
  z_alpha_two <- qnorm(1 - alpha/2)
  noncentrality <- delta_p / se
  
  # Power for two-sided test
  # P(reject H0 | H1) = P(|Z| > z_alpha | Z ~ N(noncentrality, 1))
  # = P(Z > z_alpha - noncentrality) + P(Z < -z_alpha - noncentrality)
  
  power_right <- 1 - pnorm(z_alpha_two - noncentrality)
  power_left <- pnorm(-z_alpha_two - noncentrality)
  power_total <- power_right + power_left
  
  return(list(power = power_total, se = se, noncentrality = noncentrality))
}

# Cluster-rate coefficient-of-variation approximation
# Field Trials of Health Interventions, Chapter 5, Section 6.1
# With additive one-cluster correction

# Input parameters
p_control <- 0.010      # Control event rate per child-week
p_treatment <- 0.005    # Treatment event rate per child-week
m_cluster <- 2500       # Exposure per cluster (child-weeks)
kappa <- 0.25           # Between-cluster coefficient of variation
alpha <- 0.05           # Two-sided significance level
target_power <- 0.90    # Target power
z_alpha <- qnorm(1 - alpha/2)  # Two-sided critical value
z_beta <- qnorm(target_power)   # Power parameter (one-sided)

cat("=== Cluster-Rate Coefficient-of-Variation Sample Size Calculation ===\n")
cat("Control rate (per child-week):", p_control, "\n")
cat("Treatment rate (per child-week):", p_treatment, "\n")
cat("Exposure per cluster (child-weeks):", m_cluster, "\n")
cat("Between-cluster CV (κ):", kappa, "\n")
cat("Two-sided alpha:", alpha, "\n")
cat("Target power:", target_power, "\n")
cat("z_alpha (two-sided):", z_alpha, "\n")
cat("z_beta (power):", z_beta, "\n\n")

# The approximation formula (without one-cluster correction):
# n = (z_alpha + z_beta)^2 * [κ^2 * (p_0 + p_1) + (p_0 + p_1)/(m_cluster)] / (p_0 - p_1)^2
# 
# With additive one-cluster correction:
# n_corrected = n + 1

# Difference in rates
delta_p <- p_control - p_treatment
cat("Difference in rates (p_0 - p_1):", delta_p, "\n\n")

# Average rate
p_avg <- (p_control + p_treatment) / 2
cat("Average rate (p_0 + p_1)/2:", p_avg, "\n")
cat("Sum of rates (p_0 + p_1):", p_control + p_treatment, "\n\n")

# Variance inflation term from CV approximation
# The cluster-rate CV method accounts for:
# 1. Between-cluster heterogeneity in rates: κ^2 * (p_0 + p_1)
# 2. Within-cluster Poisson variation: (p_0 + p_1) / m_cluster

variance_term_cv <- kappa^2 * (p_control + p_treatment)
variance_term_poisson <- (p_control + p_treatment) / m_cluster
total_variance_term <- variance_term_cv + variance_term_poisson

cat("Variance term from between-cluster CV: κ^2 * (p_0 + p_1) =", variance_term_cv, "\n")
cat("Variance term from Poisson variation: (p_0 + p_1) / m =", variance_term_poisson, "\n")
cat("Total variance term:", total_variance_term, "\n\n")

# Sample size per arm (before one-cluster correction)
z_sum_squared <- (z_alpha + z_beta)^2
numerator <- z_sum_squared * total_variance_term
denominator <- delta_p^2

n_uncorrected <- numerator / denominator

cat("(z_alpha + z_beta)^2 =", z_sum_squared, "\n")
cat("Numerator:", numerator, "\n")
cat("Denominator:", denominator, "\n")
cat("Uncorrected clusters per arm: n =", n_uncorrected, "\n\n")

# Apply additive one-cluster correction
n_corrected <- n_uncorrected + 1
cat("After one-cluster correction: n + 1 =", n_corrected, "\n\n")

# Round upward to next integer
n_final <- ceiling(n_corrected)
cat("Final clusters per arm (rounded upward):", n_final, "\n\n")

# Verification: compute achieved power at the final sample size
# We can verify by computing power backward using the formula
# Rearranging: power = P(Z > z_crit - (effect size * sqrt(n)))

# For the two-sided test:
# Effect size per cluster = delta_p / sqrt(variance_term)
se_per_cluster <- sqrt(total_variance_term / n_final)
z_critical_one_sided <- z_alpha  # For one-sided test at two-sided alpha/2
effect_size_standardized <- delta_p / sqrt(total_variance_term)
z_power_achieved <- sqrt(n_final) * effect_size_standardized

# For two-sided test, power = P(|Z| > z_alpha) under H1
# This is approximately P(Z > z_alpha - effect_size_standardized * sqrt(n))
power_achieved <- pnorm(z_power_achieved - z_alpha)

cat("=== Verification of Achieved Power ===\n")
cat("Standard error per cluster:", se_per_cluster, "\n")
cat("Standardized effect size:", effect_size_standardized, "\n")
cat("Z-statistic for power (noncentrality):", z_power_achieved, "\n")
cat("Achieved power (approximate):", power_achieved, "\n\n")

# More precise power calculation for two-sided test:
# Under H1, the test statistic sqrt(n) * delta_p / sqrt(total_variance_term) follows N(delta_p*sqrt(n)/sqrt(variance), 1)
# Power = P(|Z| > z_alpha | H1) where Z ~ N(sqrt(n)*delta_p/sqrt(variance), 1)
# = P(Z > z_alpha) + P(Z < -z_alpha) where Z ~ N(noncentrality, 1)

noncentrality <- sqrt(n_final) * delta_p / sqrt(total_variance_term)
power_upper <- 1 - pnorm(z_alpha - noncentrality)
power_lower <- pnorm(-z_alpha - noncentrality)
power_two_sided <- power_upper + power_lower

cat("=== Refined Power Calculation (Two-Sided) ===\n")
cat("Noncentrality parameter:", noncentrality, "\n")
cat("P(Z > z_alpha | H1):", power_upper, "\n")
cat("P(Z < -z_alpha | H1):", power_lower, "\n")
cat("Total two-sided power:", power_two_sided, "\n\n")

# Final results
cat("=== FINAL RESULTS ===\n")
cat("Sample size (clusters per arm):", n_final, "\n")
cat("Method: cluster_rate_cv (with one-cluster correction)\n")
cat("Achieved power:", round(power_two_sided, 4), "\n")

# Independent implementation of cluster-rate CV approximation
# Reference: Field Trials of Health Interventions, Chapter 5, Section 6.1

# Study parameters
p0 <- 0.010      # Control rate per child-week
p1 <- 0.005      # Treatment rate per child-week
m <- 2500        # Exposure per cluster (child-weeks)
kappa <- 0.25    # Between-cluster coefficient of variation
alpha <- 0.05    # Two-sided alpha
beta <- 0.10     # One minus target power
target_power <- 0.90

# Critical values (two-sided test)
z_alpha <- qnorm(1 - alpha/2)      # Two-sided critical value
z_beta <- qnorm(1 - beta)           # One-sided power critical value

cat("=== INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION ===\n\n")
cat("Input parameters:\n")
cat("  p0 (control, per child-week):", p0, "\n")
cat("  p1 (treatment, per child-week):", p1, "\n")
cat("  m (exposure per cluster):", m, "\n")
cat("  κ (between-cluster CV):", kappa, "\n")
cat("  α (two-sided):", alpha, "\n")
cat("  Target power:", target_power, "\n")
cat("  z_α (two-sided, α/2 =", alpha/2, "):", z_alpha, "\n")
cat("  z_β (one-sided, β =", beta, "):", z_beta, "\n\n")

# The cluster-rate CV approximation formula:
# Var(rate_difference_per_cluster) = κ²(p₀ + p₁) + (p₀ + p₁)/m
# 
# Sample size formula (per arm):
# n = (z_α + z_β)² × Var / (p₀ - p₁)²

# Variance components
var_cv <- kappa^2 * (p0 + p1)       # Between-cluster variation
var_poisson <- (p0 + p1) / m        # Poisson variation (binomial approximation)
var_total <- var_cv + var_poisson

cat("Variance components:\n")
cat("  κ² × (p₀ + p₁):", var_cv, "\n")
cat("  (p₀ + p₁)/m:", var_poisson, "\n")
cat("  Total variance:", var_total, "\n\n")

# Effect size
delta_p <- p0 - p1
cat("Effect size (p₀ - p₁):", delta_p, "\n\n")

# Sample size calculation (uncorrected)
z_sum <- z_alpha + z_beta
n_uncorr <- (z_sum^2 * var_total) / (delta_p^2)

cat("Sample size calculation:\n")
cat("  (z_α + z_β)²:", z_sum^2, "\n")
cat("  n_uncorrected = (z_α + z_β)² × Var / (Δp)²\n")
cat("  n_uncorrected:", n_uncorr, "\n\n")

# Additive one-cluster correction
n_corrected <- n_uncorr + 1
cat("After one-cluster correction: n + 1 =", n_corrected, "\n")

# Final rounding (upward)
n_final <- ceiling(n_corrected)
cat("After ceiling rounding: n_final =", n_final, "\n\n")

# ==================================================
# Power verification at the final sample size
# ==================================================

compute_power_at_n <- function(n_per_arm, p0, p1, m, kappa, alpha) {
  # Variance per cluster
  var_total <- kappa^2 * (p0 + p1) + (p0 + p1) / m
  
  # Standard error of rate difference
  se <- sqrt(var_total / n_per_arm)
  
  # Effect size
  delta_p <- p0 - p1
  
  # Noncentrality parameter (for one-sided test)
  z_alpha_two <- qnorm(1 - alpha/2)
  noncentrality <- delta_p / se
  
  # Power for two-sided test
  # P(reject H0 | H1) = P(|Z| > z_alpha | Z ~ N(noncentrality, 1))
  # = P(Z > z_alpha - noncentrality) + P(Z < -z_alpha - noncentrality)
  
  power_right <- 1 - pnorm(z_alpha_two - noncentrality)
  power_left <- pnorm(-z_alpha_two - noncentrality)
  power_total <- power_right + power_left
  
  return(list(power = power_total, se = se, noncentrality = noncentrality))
}

# Check power at final sample size
result_final <- compute_power_at_n(n_final, p0, p1, m, kappa, alpha)
cat("Power verification at n =", n_final, ":\n")
cat("  Standard error:", result_final$se, "\n")
cat("  Noncentrality parameter:", result_final$noncentrality, "\n")
cat("  Achieved power:", result_final$power, "\n\n")

cat("Power at n =", n_final - 1, ":\n")
cat("  Achieved power:", result_preceding$power, "\n\n")

cat("n =", n_final, ": power =", format(result_final$power, digits=6),

cat("=== CONCLUSION ===\n")
cat("Clusters per arm (target power 90%): ", n_final, "\n")
cat("Achieved power: ", format(result_final$power, digits=6), "\n")
